CAS — 59989-18-3. Profile Eniluracil inactivates the enzyme dihydropyrimidine dehydroge- nase, which plays an important role in the metabolism of the an- tineoplastic fluorouracil (p.723). Eniluracil increases the bio- availability of fluorouracil, particularly when the latter is given by mouth. It is being investigated as an adjunct to fluorouracil therapy in the treatment of colorectal, breast, and pancreatic can- cer. However, the optimal dose and regimen remains to be deter- mined.
